reported_protocols.label: Typical synthesis with alternative conditions

reaction_medium.description: 4 g of TOPO or TOPO + HPA
reaction_medium.mass_scope: reaction-medium charge described as TOPO (or TOPO + HPA)
reaction_medium.mass_fraction_denominator_note: The paper reports percentages by weight / HPA in TOPO but does not separately give the component masses or explicitly define the percentage denominator. No HPA mass was calculated.

reported_protocols.thermal_variant_note: Corresponding alternatives are presented in the same order in the before- and after-injection sentences. They are alternatives, not successive heating steps.

injection_time.visual_verification: Printed double-less-than sign, not a plain less-than sign.

steps.action: prepare hot TOPO or TOPO + HPA medium
steps.evidence_status: hot medium and amount explicit; heating procedure implicit in injection into hot medium

steps.action: quickly inject precursor stock into hot reaction medium
allow growth after injection; take aliquots for UV-visible and photoluminescence monitoring
steps.temperature_note: The paper describes a temperature drop; it gives no cooling rate or time-resolved temperature trace.

steps.action: repeat injections of the same precursor stock when needed
steps.purpose: replenish monomer; maintain or recover rod morphology
steps.reported_volume_constraint: secondary injection less than 40% of the stock solution volume injected previously
steps.evidence_note: Do not assume a fixed reinjection volume or a repeated 0.4 geometric schedule; the text does not provide a full sequence.

steps.action: remove heating mantle to stop the reaction

surfactant_sweep.constraints: Do not call these mol%. Do not infer a continuous calibrated aspect-ratio response, a threshold guaranteed at all temperatures, or a full factorial condition grid. The 8% best variant also changes precursor stock mass ratio.

stages.description: As monomer is depleted, the aspect ratio gradually approaches one while the short axis grows.
Additional injections can maintain rods or recover rods from dots by replenishing monomer, giving bigger rods.

growth_narrative.display_note: Use a qualitative, stage-based diagram. No numerical time trajectory, reaction duration, growth-rate constant or predictive simulator can be extracted from this letter.

figure_outcomes.body_connections: Text uses a,b,d,e to illustrate early axial growth and c,f,g to illustrate larger rods obtained with monomer replenishment. It does not provide the individual samples’ concentrations, exact times, injection counts or temperature choices.
figure_outcomes.measurement_caution: Scale bars are not sample size statistics. No individual lengths or distributions were estimated from the image.

figure_outcomes.dimension_method: Sizes and aspect ratios inferred from experimental diffraction patterns using the displayed simulations.
observations: Short-axis dimensions match within experimental error.
TEM/XRD support a wurtzite long axis along c; body reports fewer stacking faults than in spherical CdSe.
figure_outcomes.caution: Here c/a labels nanocrystal long/short dimensions, not crystallographic unit-cell lattice constants. No match to Figure 1 or a unique recipe is stated.

observations: View perpendicular to c shows faceted hexagonal cross sections.
The paper reports micrometre-scale c-axis alignment with an optimal solvent/substrate combination.
figure_outcomes.caution: This is an orientation image, not a growth-time series or a quantitative morphology-vs-time plot.

panels.observation: Short-axis lengths comparable to dot diameters in a; absorption/emission separation is larger in rods.

panels.comparison_condition: Same optical density at excitation wavelength
panels.observation: Initial shell growth increases photoluminescence; thicker shells reduce yield again. Body discusses CdS or ZnS shells but does not assign a shell composition to this plotted series.

panels.sample: CdSe rods in stretched poly(vinyl-butyral), PVB
panels.measurement: PL parallel and perpendicular to stretching direction
panels.control: Dots prepared by the same alignment method showed no polarization anisotropy.

caption_optical_density.scope: caption says all samples shown in this figure

body_luminescence_yields.dot_maximum_scope: A maximum observed in dots, not the quantum rods or an assigned sample in this recipe.

figure_outcomes.caution: Do not use the core/shell yield, PVB alignment processing or dot maximum yield as results of the unshelled best-rod stock recipe. Spectral maxima have not been digitized or invented.

headline_outcome.assignment: Study-level maximum; no unique full recipe or figure panel assignment supplied.

critical_missing_fields: Absolute masses and stock concentration: mass ratios plus a 2 mL aliquot do not determine individual masses without further stock properties.
Detailed stock preparation order, mixing, dissolution time and atmosphere.
Reagent suppliers and numeric purity specifications for the controlled HPA/TOPO rod protocol.
Precise meaning of the weight-percentage denominator and separate HPA / TOPO component masses.
Vessel geometry, volume, stirring, atmosphere, degassing and drying.
Temperature ramp, pre-injection hold, thermal lag and post-injection temperature trace.
Reaction durations and aliquot sampling schedule / volumes.
Exact number, time and volume of secondary injections for each sample.
Cooling trajectory and endpoint after removal of heating mantle.
Workup, precipitation, centrifugation, redispersion, ligand purification, isolation yield and storage.
Complete sample-to-recipe linkage for all figures, including the study-level maximum aspect ratio.
Shell-growth reagents, quantities, thicknesses and assigned shell material for Figure 4c.

recommended_site_presentation.default: Present the high-aspect-ratio condition set as a reported variant with missing fields visibly marked. Present the complete available typical-family workflow alongside it, not silently merged with it.
recommended_site_presentation.timeline: Sequence or qualitative stages; no fabricated minutes or heating-rate sliders.
recommended_site_presentation.parameter_comparison: Discrete source-reported HPA weight-percent conditions, paired thermal alternatives and stock-composition alternatives.
recommended_site_presentation.structure_view: Idealized wurtzite rod, explicitly illustrative; separate reported Figure 2 / Figure 4 dimensions can be selectable characterization examples with no full recipe mapping.
recommended_site_presentation.evidence_view: Citation pointers to PDF page 2 for conditions, PDF page 1 / Figure 2 for XRD dimensions, and PDF page 2 / Figure 4 for optical samples.
avoid: Oleic acid / oleylamine / ODE from the prior example
